task.description: WF-03 after FAIL of step 7 — fix the tests by the two MEDIUM survivors in handoffs/ISS-0103-20261103-01/step-07-test-design-validator.json (read result.summary and issues fully). Survivor 1: the helper waitGone checking groupGone(pid) only (mutant M05) is not seen, because every victim in E2K-62 is a group leader. Add to E2K-62 (or a new test) a LIVE process that is NOT a group leader (for example a child in the leader's group, or a plain child with its own pid not equal to its pgid) and require that waitGone rejects for it within a short limit, so that a helper looking only at the group is red. Survivor 2: the seven call-site mutants survive because the real E2K-18/E2K-38 cannot go red on this Mac, so only the helper is pinned, not its use. Add one source guard test (the repository already has such tests, e.g. E2K-50 reads the test file text) that reads tools/test/e2e-kit.test.js and checks, for the bodies of E2K-18 and E2K-38, that they call waitGone( at the three places (5 scenarios loop, the signal loop, the preflight) and contain no direct assert.ok(pidGone(...) ...) or assert.ok(groupGone(...) ...) of a killed process; make the guard robust to prettier reformatting (match on tokens, not on exact lines) and make it fail with a message that names the test and the line. Keep it small; do not weaken any existing assertion; test( and assert. counts must not go down. Prove both new checks red on mutants in a temporary copy outside the project: M05 (group only) for survivor 1; for survivor 2 the call-site mutants (assertion removed, back to the single check, 1 ms limit at each of the three sites) — name which of them the guard catches; a mutant that only changes the limit value may be pinned by a lower bound of the limit in the guard (waitGone( called with no limit below 1000, or with the default) — decide and say why. Finish with one npm test run green; prettier and eslint on the file clean. Do not commit. Do not write absolute machine paths or other projects' names into project files. Kill only your own processes by process id (no word splitting: kill each pid explicitly). Report in at most 8 lines.

result.summary: Step 7 FAIL item (e), two MEDIUM survivors, both closed in tools/test/e2e-kit.test.js only. Survivor 1 (M05, helper looks at the group only): E2K-62 now also spawns a live process that is not a group leader (no detached, so its pid is no group id), requires groupGone(pid) to be true for it (the blind spot), and requires waitGone(pid, name, 300) to reject with the name and pid in the message and the process to stay alive; it is killed by pid in finally. Survivor 2 (seven call-site mutants): new test E2K-63, a source guard, reads this file by tokens, cuts out the bodies of E2K-18 and E2K-38 and requires exactly 1 and 2 assert.ok(await waitGone(...)) places, no pidGone( at all, groupGone( only of leader and pids.browser (E2K-38 after the loop waits), and a limit argument, when given, that is a number of at least 1000 ms (the default is 5000). The message names the test and the line.
